facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; no forced conversion, and you can keep foreign earnings in foreign currency.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: individuals can freely open foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways like iPay88 and Billplz weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: Register a sole proprietorship with SSM via EzBiz: RM30 a year in your name.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the Inland Revenue Board, issued to citizens aged 18 and over.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Work done in Malaysia is taxed at 0–30%, even for foreign clients.
facts.L4_vat_gst: No VAT; 8% service tax applies only above RM500,000 of taxable services.
facts.L5_data_protection: PDPA 2010 (amended 2024): appoint a DPO and report data breaches.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund periods not confirmed yet.

watch_out.text: The foreign-income exemption doesn't cover remote work done from Malaysia.
